item.title: Nationwide Ground Stop Snarls Air Travel Across the U.S.
item.description: A communications failure at air traffic control centers forced the F.A.A. to halt departures nationwide for more than four hours, stranding travelers at airports across the country.

item.title: Pope Leo Returns to Peru, the Country That Shaped Him
item.description: Tens of thousands gathered in Chiclayo as the first American pope returned to the diocese he once led, the first papal visit to Peru since 2018.
